notes.title: Bee Aware 2.0
notes.notes:
Busy updating Bee Aware! to version 2.0! I revamped the startscreen, moved the games to a seperate hub, added a lot of different animations, spiced up some of the games, added a new mini game (a classic text adventure, called Bee Brave!), added a new mini-minigame (Whack-a-Bee), added transition animations for when you lose or win a game and more!
Well, no re-release date planned, so please be patient, it can take up to several months before Bee Aware 2.0 is finished (ofcourse, the update is free for current owners of Bee Aware!).
Click on 'Read more' for screenshots!
